name: GD FPS Core
description: MAX ULTRA X hotfix: fixes background-effect visibility call target for Windows GD 2.2081. Retains visual reductions, optional layer hiding, profiling, and Wave Trail preservation.

perf-header.name: Performance Profiler
perf-header.description: Profiling is disabled by default to minimize monitoring overhead. Enable only when diagnosing performance.

frame-monitor.name: Frame cadence monitor
frame-monitor.description: Measures the interval between drawScene calls and the CPU time spent inside drawScene. This is not a GPU timer or exact monitor-present FPS.

profile-game-update.name: Profile main game update
profile-game-update.description: Measures inclusive CPU time in GJBaseGameLayer::update. Adds small measurement overhead.

profile-player-update.name: Profile player updates
profile-player-update.description: Measures CPU time in PlayerObject::update and counts update calls. Adds small measurement overhead.

profile-particle-update.name: Profile particle simulation
profile-particle-update.description: Measures CCParticleSystem::update time, counts calls and samples active particle counts. Adds measurement overhead.

profile-visibility-update.name: Profile PlayLayer object visibility update
profile-visibility-update.description: Measures CPU time in PlayLayer::updateVisibility and reports the loaded level object count. Adds small diagnostic overhead.

profile-wave-trail.name: Profile Wave Trail renderer
profile-wave-trail.description: Measures executed HardStreak::updateStroke CPU time. Diagnostic only; adds timing overhead while enabled.

profile-object-setup.name: Profile GameObject setup
profile-object-setup.description: Measures GameObject::customSetup CPU time while objects are created/configured. Diagnostic only; adds timing overhead while enabled.

profile-object-parsing.name: Profile object parser
profile-object-parsing.description: Measures GameObject::objectFromVector CPU time, useful for large level loading/creation spikes. Diagnostic only; adds timing overhead while enabled.

report-interval.name: Report interval (frames)
report-interval.description: Number of frame samples in each report. Higher values smooth out short spikes.

visual-header.name: EXTREME VISUAL REDUCTION
visual-header.description: MAX ULTRA profile: suppress supported particle triggers and emitters, stop/unschedule remaining particle systems, remove player/object secondary visuals, force native Extra LDM, and hide gameplay decorations. Gameplay physics, triggers, collision and inputs remain active. The Wave Trail is kept but its stored geometry is simplified and bounded.

disable-all-particles.name: Disable EVERY CCParticleSystem effect
disable-all-particles.description: Suppresses the supported non-inline GJBaseGameLayer particle-trigger entry point, blocks GameObject and PlayerObject emitters, and stops/unschedules remaining Cocos particle systems. The Wave Trail uses HardStreak and is kept.

disable-shader-updates.name: Disable shader-layer updates
disable-shader-updates.description: Skips cosmetic GJBaseGameLayer shader-layer animation updates. It does not change player physics, collision, triggers, or input handling; shader-driven background/visual animation may disappear.

disable-scene-glitter.name: Disable scene glitter
disable-scene-glitter.description: Suppresses GJBaseGameLayer glitter visuals. Does not block trigger logic.

disable-gravity-transition-visual.name: Disable gravity transition visuals
disable-gravity-transition-visual.description: Suppresses the visual gravity-flip effect only. Gravity and player physics remain unchanged.

disable-object-glow.name: Hide level object glows
disable-object-glow.description: Hides the separate glow sprite attached to level objects. May reduce overdraw, but changes appearance.

disable-object-particles.name: Stop level object particles
disable-object-particles.description: Prevents GameObject particle emitters from being created or attached, using the native m_hasNoParticles guard.

disable-player-particles.name: Stop player burst/ground particles
disable-player-particles.description: Blocks PlayerObject particle attachment before it happens and stops supported player particle emitters. The HardStreak Wave Trail is independent and remains visible.

disable-player-glow.name: Hide player icon/vehicle glow
disable-player-glow.description: Hides player icon and vehicle glow sprites. Changes appearance.

disable-object-shine.name: Skip object shine animations
disable-object-shine.description: Prevents GameObject shine effects from being created. Changes appearance.

disable-trigger-flash.name: Skip trigger flash effects
disable-trigger-flash.description: Skips EffectGameObject trigger flash visuals. Trigger logic and timing still run.

disable-ring-pulse.name: Skip ring activation pulses
disable-ring-pulse.description: Skips the visual circle spawned when a RingObject activates. Ring behavior is unchanged.

disable-player-circle-effects.name: Skip player transition circles
disable-player-circle-effects.description: Skips the supported spawn, dual, portal and scale transition circles. The inline spawnCircle2 variant is intentionally not hooked; player mode transitions remain unchanged.

disable-death-effect.name: Disable player death effect
disable-death-effect.description: Suppresses the player death burst/visual effect. Death state, reset timing and gameplay remain unchanged.

disable-non-wave-trail.name: Disable all non-Wave player trails
disable-non-wave-trail.description: Disables standard/ship CCMotionStreak trails. The Wave Trail HardStreak remains visible.

disable-ghost-effect.name: Disable ghost trail/effect
disable-ghost-effect.description: Prevents the temporary ghost visual effect while keeping the player state and gameplay unchanged.

disable-spider-dash-visual.name: Skip Spider dash visual
disable-spider-dash-visual.description: Skips the Spider dash visual effect only. Spider movement and collision behavior are unchanged.

wave-point-spacing.name: Wave Trail minimum point spacing
wave-point-spacing.description: Minimum squared-distance filter for closely spaced Wave Trail points. Larger spacing reduces geometry; sharp turns are retained.

wave-trail-sample-step.name: Wave Trail sample reduction
wave-trail-sample-step.description: Keep approximately one point per N incoming straight-line samples. 4 is the aggressive default; sharp turns and long gaps force extra points to preserve the trail shape.

wave-trail-max-gap.name: Wave Trail maximum segment gap
wave-trail-max-gap.description: Forces a new Wave Trail point after this distance. Larger values reduce the retained geometry but can make the trail more angular.

wave-trail-max-points.name: Wave Trail maximum retained points
wave-trail-max-points.description: Hard cap for the Wave Trail point array. Lower values reduce its memory use and geometry cost, but shorten the visible trail. The Wave Trail itself stays enabled.

disable-player-fire.name: Disable all non-Wave player fire/dash visuals
disable-player-fire.description: Hides robot/swing/dash fire sprites and skips swing-fire visual updates. Does not touch the Wave Trail.

disable-player-impact.name: Disable player impact/flashing effects
disable-player-impact.description: Skips the supported player bump visual. PlayerObject::flashPlayer is inline in the Windows 2.2081 bindings and cannot be hooked directly; global particle suppression removes the remaining particle-based flashes.

disable-player-completion.name: Disable player completion effect
disable-player-completion.description: Skips the player completion-only visual effect. Level completion logic remains active.

disable-player-spawn.name: Disable player spawn effect
disable-player-spawn.description: Skips the player spawn visual effect only.

disable-high-detail-objects.name: Force native Ultra LDM (filter High Detail during parsing)
disable-high-detail-objects.description: For gameplay only, forces the engine Low Detail + Extra LDM flags and passes lowDetail=true to GameObject::objectFromVector. Objects marked High Detail can be omitted before entering the runtime object list, reducing draw and object-list work. Does not skip gameplay logic for remaining objects.

hide-decoration-objects.name: Hide decoration-only objects
hide-decoration-objects.description: Hides objects marked as decoration during gameplay. They remain allocated and in the level object lists; triggers and editor previews are excluded.

wave-trail-render-step.name: Wave Trail renderer refresh interval
wave-trail-render-step.description: Rebuild Wave Trail geometry once every N scheduled updates. Default 2 halves its geometry rebuild cadence while keeping the last rendered trail visible.

disable-camera-shake.name: Disable camera shake
disable-camera-shake.description: Removes only visual camera-shake requests. Camera/level logic is unchanged.

disable-player-burst.name: Disable player burst visuals
disable-player-burst.description: Stops supported robot/swing burst particle emitters. The inline playBurstEffect method itself is not hooked; global particle suppression also stops remaining particle systems.

scene-header.name: SCENE / LAYER REDUCTION
scene-header.description: Additional optional reductions for background, ground and midground art. Ground and midground are off by default because they can affect visual readability.

disable-background-effects.name: Disable background visual effects
disable-background-effects.description: Disables the engine background-effect visibility path for gameplay. Visual only; no collision, trigger, or player-state changes.

hide-ground-layer.name: Hide ground layer
hide-ground-layer.description: Hides the ground art layer to reduce visual work. Ground collision and gameplay remain active. May make the level harder to read.

hide-midground-layer.name: Hide midground layer
hide-midground-layer.description: Hides the midground visual layer. Gameplay and collision remain active.
